top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

top_deficiency_types.title: Have stairways and smokeproof enclosures used as exits that meet safety requirements.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.

top_deficiency_types.title: Allow residents to self-administer drugs if determined clinically appropriate.
Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.
